title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Billing Note: Amount of the Alignment Check Charge
content:
The alignment check charge on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is the tier's alignment check fee for each alignment check recorded on the order when the charge is posted, rounded to the cent, half up.

## The figure, defined

- **The fee for one check** is the tier's alignment check fee, in US dollars.
- **The number of checks** is the number of alignment checks recorded on the order on the day the charge is posted.
- **The charge** is the fee for one check multiplied by the number of checks, and only that final figure is rounded to the cent; nothing is rounded before it.
- **Rounding** is half up: a figure whose fraction of a cent is one half or more goes up to the next cent, and a figure that falls short of the half cent by no more than 0.0001 of a cent is treated as reaching it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier fee of 59.95 USD)

| Alignment checks recorded on the order when the charge is posted | Fee for one check | Alignment check charge |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 59.95 | 59.95 |
| 2 | 59.95 | 119.90 |
| 3 | 59.95 | 179.85 |

Worked through for three checks: 59.95 multiplied by 3 is 179.85, which is already a whole number of cents, so the charge is 179.85 USD.
